why: The JavaScript API page is the index of window.SF (owner D17, 2026-11-10): every public name of core/contracts/public-js-api.json, grouped by what brings it, links to its function page or to the page that describes it; a component's script API links to the component's page. text is the short line the index shows (the contract's summary is the release's record, not an author's line); a component row shows the page title. scripts/build-smart-reference.mjs fails --check when a public name has no row here or a row names no public name.
